articles.resume: Prior was -9.8 October had risen 2.3 points to -9.8, the highest since January and well above expectations of -11.8. articles.titre: How does EIA compare different types of energy?
articles.resume: To compare production and consumption across different resources, we convert to a common energy metric, British thermal units (Btu), which typically measures the heat content of the fuels such as petroleum, natural gas, and coal that are burned for energy. For energy sources such as hydropower, wind, solar, and geothermal that aren't combusted to create energy, we apply a constant conversion factor based on the heat content of electricity.

articles.titre: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
articles.resume: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructure. Hurricane Isaias is the first hurricane of the 2026 Atlantic season and will be the largest storm system to make landfall in the region since Hurricane Helene in September 2024.
